metadata.title: Solar System: True or False?
metadata.description: Quick facts about the planets — decide whether each statement is true or false.
metadata.subject: science

statements.explanation: The Sun is a medium-sized star at the centre of our solar system.

statements.statement: Mars is the largest planet in the solar system.
The Moon makes its own light.
Earth takes about 365 days to orbit the Sun.
Venus is the closest planet to the Sun.
Neptune is farther from the Sun than Uranus.
There is no gravity on the Moon.
statements.explanation: The Moon's gravity is about one sixth of Earth's.
